major_cooldowns.name: Avenging Wrath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Your main cooldown: send it as often as possible, lining the 30 second window up with a long damage window rather than a single spike, and keep the standard Holy Shock and spender rotation running underneath it.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Cast id from the parse (5 casts). Ids 384376 and 454351 share the name and are talent/aura rows. Guide states the 2 minute cooldown and 30 second duration.

major_cooldowns.name: Avenging Crusader
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Replaces Avenging Wrath: while it is up, press Judgment and Crusader Strike on cooldown so their damage heals allies, and still dump Holy Power into Light of Dawn before you cap.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Id 394088 is name-verified only and was not pressed in the sampled parse, which ran the Avenging Wrath build; the guide describes it as a button. No source gives its cooldown, only that it is much shorter than Avenging Wrath's 2 minutes; tooltip gives the 15 second duration.

major_cooldowns.name: Divine Toll
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Keep it on cooldown and cast it at an ally when you want the 5 Holy Shocks to heal, since targeting an enemy sends them at enemies first; on Herald of the Sun it is your Dawnlight generator.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Shares a choice node with Holy Prism and is replaced by Holy Armaments on Lightsmith, so builds exist with zero casts.

major_cooldowns.name: Holy Prism
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Keep it on cooldown and cast it on an enemy so it does the AoE healing around you; on Herald of the Sun it is a Dawnlight generator.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parse but a real castable ability; shares a choice node with Divine Toll.

major_cooldowns.name: Sacred Weapon
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Lightsmith only: keep both Holy Armaments charges moving, casting Sacred Weapon on yourself for the healing bonus while the extra armament lands on another healer.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Guide refers to this id as Holy Armaments(spell=432472). Cooldown from the tooltip's 1 minute recharge, 2 charges. The table's Holy Bulwark row (227817) carries an encounter tooltip, so it is not used here.

major_cooldowns.name: Aura Mastery
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Keep Devotion Aura selected and press this just before a heavy raid hit for the 12% party-wide damage reduction, or on the mechanic your healing roster assigned it to.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Cast id from the parse; 317929 is the passive row of the same name.

rule.description: Infusion of Light into Flash of Light or Judgment
rule.action: Consume every Infusion of Light: use Flash of Light whenever healing is needed, since the proc makes it instant and increases its healing by 200%, and only spend it on Judgment when no healing is needed and you want the extra Holy Power.

rule.description: Dawnlight spent after Divine Toll or Holy Prism
rule.action: On Herald of the Sun, follow every Divine Toll or Holy Prism with Holy Power spenders: the next 2 spenders apply Dawnlight, so sitting on the charges throws that healing away.

rule.description: Shield of the Righteous only at high Holy Power
rule.action: Dump Holy Power into Shield of the Righteous only at 4-5 Holy Power and only when no healing is needed; below that, keep the Holy Power banked for Light of Dawn or Word of Glory when damage lands unexpectedly.
